bootstrap_authorization: The human repository owner's current request adopts the attached addendum. The attachment hashes identify the instruction bytes; they are not verification evidence.
registry_semantics: A rule record describes a contract and its present enforcement status. Record presence is never a derivation of the conclusion.

premises: Exact policy and environment identities are available.
side_conditions: A new policy cannot authorize its own weakening.
rules.conclusion: The observation has an explicit, bounded trust foundation.

soundness_evidence.reason: Filesystem, JSON, and process adapters have no checked Lean refinement proof.

rules.failure_interpretation: REJECT means the declared foundation does not match; operational failure remains ERROR.
rules.compatibility: Changes require a new version evaluated under the prior policy and explicit owner authorization.

rules.applicability: Git-tracked and nonignored untracked repository artifacts.
premises: NUL-delimited Git discovery and no-follow reads complete without drift.
side_conditions: Tracked deletions, conflicts, submodules, links, and nonregular entries are reported separately.
rules.conclusion: Catalog and independently discovered artifact identities agree.
rules.execution_mode: Fresh read-only working-tree scan; no ignored artifacts are silently admitted.

soundness_evidence.reason: Discovery implementation is tested but not formally refined to the filesystem model.

rules.failure_interpretation: Any omission, unsafe entry, or observed drift rejects inventory acceptance.
rules.compatibility: Scope changes require a registry version change.

rules.applicability: Every regular artifact in the declared snapshot.
premises: The retained basis bytes are available through stable no-follow reads.
side_conditions: Ranges are ordered, nonoverlapping, and cover exactly [0,size).
rules.conclusion: Concatenating the declared ranges reproduces the exact artifact bytes.
rules.execution_mode: In-memory byte reconstruction and SHA-256 comparison.

soundness_evidence.gap: The Python range interpreter is not proved to implement the Lean model.

rules.failure_interpretation: REJECT establishes only that exact restoration failed, not that artifact content is mathematically false.
rules.compatibility: Range-map schema changes require a new rule version.

premises: Every declared input and the generator identity matches.
side_conditions: The recipe has no undeclared time, network, randomness, host-path, or ambient-package input.
rules.conclusion: The generated bytes equal the cataloged output bytes.
rules.execution_mode: Deterministic in-process rendering for registered views; external commands are recorded but not assumed successful.

soundness_evidence.gap: Concrete generators lack checked refinements and the complete generator census is pending.

rules.failure_interpretation: A failed regeneration blocks Reconstructible; it does not permit relabeling the output as literal.
rules.compatibility: Recipe and generator changes invalidate dependent receipts.

rules.applicability: Every byte range of each cataloged artifact.
premises: Each range names an available literal origin or exact generation rule.
side_conditions: No generated output is relabeled after failed regeneration.
rules.conclusion: Every artifact byte has a noncircular accountable origin.
rules.execution_mode: Catalog graph and range coverage validation.

soundness_evidence.reason: Origin classification and authorship review are not formally verified.

rules.failure_interpretation: An origin gap blocks reconstruction without asserting anything about theorem validity.

rules.applicability: Every declaration and semantically significant Lean occurrence.
side_conditions: Unsupported source mappings are reported rather than guessed.
rules.conclusion: Occurrences resolve to their exact meanings and dependencies.
rules.execution_mode: No repository-wide semantic occurrence exporter is implemented.

soundness_evidence.reason: Declaration inventories and source parsing are not complete semantic maps.

rules.failure_interpretation: UNKNOWN; no binding-coverage claim is admitted.
rules.compatibility: Requires a pinned Lean-compatible semantic export schema.

side_conditions: Subject classification receives declaration-level human review.
rules.conclusion: Source uses the approved mathematical subject/object layout.
rules.execution_mode: Static structural check plus reviewed authoritative map.

soundness_evidence.reason: Mathematical placement judgment is not reducible to the path linter.

rules.failure_interpretation: REJECT means structural policy failed; passing remains a lower bound on mathematical placement.
rules.compatibility: Existing canonical placements are retained unless reviewed at declaration level.

rules.applicability: Every maintained source and validation artifact.
premises: Exactly one source role is assigned.
side_conditions: A role label cannot hide substantive library declarations.
rules.conclusion: Library, positive, negative, audit, generator, prose, data, and evidence sets remain isolated.
rules.execution_mode: Role-aware imports, umbrella, replay, and runner checks.

soundness_evidence.reason: The source-to-role classifier is operational policy, not a proved semantic classifier.

rules.compatibility: Role changes require inventory and runner updates in one unit.

side_conditions: Identity equality, not matching counts, is required.
rules.conclusion: Library closure/replay and validation runner coverage equal their declared universes.
rules.execution_mode: Independent static enumeration and source-bound replay planning.

soundness_evidence.reason: External discovery and runner dispatch have no formal refinement proof.

rules.compatibility: New sources must enter the correct set before admission.

rules.applicability: Public declaration preservation and formally admitted claims.
premises: Trusted statement is maintained outside candidate influence.
side_conditions: Universes, binders, hypotheses, conclusion, definitions, notation, and instances are compared.
rules.conclusion: The candidate proves the intended formal contract.
rules.execution_mode: Source inventories exist; trusted elaborated statement comparison is not implemented repository-wide.

soundness_evidence.reason: No independent trusted-statement environment is available for this snapshot.

rules.failure_interpretation: UNKNOWN; source spelling or name equality cannot satisfy the rule.
rules.compatibility: Migration correspondences are versioned and reviewed.

rules.applicability: All owned library declarations and formal soundness theorems.
side_conditions: Owned declarations satisfy the fixed axiom, unsafe, partial, and placeholder policy.
rules.conclusion: The admitted formal claim has a checked derivation under the declared foundation.
rules.execution_mode: Pinned Lean kernel replay and owned-declaration audit.

soundness_evidence.reason: Current replay elaborated the library, but the owned audit rejected 18 compiler-generated partial declarations.

rules.failure_interpretation: Current mandatory gate is REJECT; a resource or busy state would instead be operational failure.
rules.compatibility: Allowed axioms remain propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound; generated-runtime exception is unchanged.

premises: All premise meanings and the rule side condition hold.
side_conditions: The rule conclusion and interpretation are exact.
rules.execution_mode: Lean theorem checking for the abstract rule model.

soundness_evidence.gap: No Python checker is yet proved to refine CheckedByteInterface, and formal checker coverage is not repository-discovery coverage.

rules.failure_interpretation: An unbound checker remains UNKNOWN even if its executable returns success.
rules.compatibility: Concrete adapters must name the exact formal checker and parser.

premises: Every derivation leaf has a justified empty-premise rule or retained literal basis.
side_conditions: All recursive premises have grounded derivations.
rules.conclusion: No unsupported cycle bootstraps an accepted conclusion.
rules.execution_mode: Lean inductive derivation and least-closure theorems.

soundness_evidence.gap: Repository registry-to-model adapter is not formalized.

rules.failure_interpretation: Cycles without grounded leaves establish no conclusion.
rules.compatibility: Legacy declaration namespaces are retained; maintained headings use mathematical object names.

rules.applicability: Every mandatory validation source and conformance checker.
premises: The target tool and all inputs are available.
side_conditions: A negative control fails for its intended diagnostic and has a passing neighbor.
rules.conclusion: The tested acceptance boundary rejects the named fault.
rules.execution_mode: Role-aware positive/negative harnesses and pure hostile fixtures.

soundness_evidence.reason: Tests are operational evidence, not proofs of checker soundness.

rules.failure_interpretation: Wrong or infrastructure-only rejection fails the control contract.
rules.compatibility: Expected diagnostics are source- and toolchain-bound.

rules.applicability: Maintained mathematical pages, README claims, docstrings, and generated catalogs.
premises: Page membership and exact source bindings are current.
side_conditions: Formal, informal, historical, and open statuses remain distinct.
rules.conclusion: The maintained explanation accurately states its verification scope.
rules.execution_mode: Registry, link, source-hash, generated-view, and hostile-fixture checks.

soundness_evidence.reason: No complete formal translation or semantic comparison exists for free prose.

rules.failure_interpretation: A structural documentation pass never establishes proof acceptance.
rules.compatibility: Historical wording remains immutable; corrections create current documentation.

premises: All declared inputs, rules, schemas, parsers, generators, and tools match the receipt.
side_conditions: Historical evidence remains bound to its original bytes.
rules.conclusion: The receipt is current for the exact claimed snapshot.
rules.execution_mode: Digest/read-set comparison with immutable historical receipts.

soundness_evidence.reason: Complete dynamic read-set capture is not implemented for every checker and generator.

rules.failure_interpretation: A stale receipt remains historical and cannot satisfy a current gate.
rules.compatibility: Any relevant input change invalidates current status unless a checked transport theorem applies.

premises: Original bytes and scope remain available.
side_conditions: No old result is rewritten or rebound as a fresh run.
rules.conclusion: Historical evidence remains inspectable with its original status.
rules.execution_mode: Immutable object restoration for the explicitly scoped archive; general evidence is retained literally.

soundness_evidence.reason: Only the causal archive has a complete tested object-store restore contract.

rules.failure_interpretation: Archive failure blocks historical reconstruction; it does not alter the recorded outcome.

rules.applicability: Claims of the Independently validated profile.
premises: Trusted statement comparison occurs outside candidate influence.
side_conditions: External checker and dependency source reconstruction cover the claimed closure.
rules.conclusion: The scoped formal results have independent proof and reconstruction validation.
rules.execution_mode: Not implemented for pinned Lean 4.33.0 in this repository.

soundness_evidence.reason: No compatible independent proof-export/checker route or cold dependency-source rebuild receipt is available.

rules.failure_interpretation: UNKNOWN or NOT_RUN blocks only the independent profile; it is never acceptance.
rules.compatibility: No toolchain upgrade is authorized by checker incompatibility.

rules.applicability: Every release or repository-wide conformance statement.
premises: Every mandatory gate for the named scope and profile is ACCEPT with COMPLETED execution.
side_conditions: Residual assumptions, audience, and unavailable inputs are disclosed.
rules.conclusion: Only the attained cumulative conformance profile is reported.
rules.execution_mode: Explicit status-vector computation; no catch-all pass.

soundness_evidence.gap: The scoped evidence types have no concrete repository adapter; operational status fields are not formally bound to repository observations.

rules.failure_interpretation: The strongest unmet gate bounds the reported profile; lower established evidence is preserved.
rules.compatibility: Profiles are cumulative and versioned by this registry.
